title: How Illumine cracked the US SaaS market from India: AI, GTM, Growth playbook
summary: In this episode of the Prime Venture Partners Podcast, Illumine co-founders Navneet Rastogi and Sourabh Agarwal share how they went from losing nearly 200 customers during COVID to building a global childcare SaaS business, competing with established US players and scaling sales from India.
llm_summary: In the Prime Venture Partners podcast, Illumine co‑founders Navneet Rastogi and Sourabh Agarwal explain how they turned a pandemic‑driven loss of almost 200 customers into a thriving global childcare SaaS platform that now rivals established U.S. players.
